fusions.name: Fang Exchange
fusions.desc: Strikes with a strand that uses up one of your afflictions on the target, dealing 9 poison damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coil and Wait
fusions.desc: Whips a venomed strand at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 poison damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach and ignores resistance, and leaving it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sloughed Skin
fusions.desc: Sheds a layer of strands that restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Venomed Blood
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 10% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.
